8021.title: Cached message navigation can remain hidden
8021.rootCauseOneLine: A missing-target result latches navigation as handled without settling reveal state, while cached rows are checked before the timeline refresh completes.
8021.proposedFix: Wait for the exact timeline query refresh, cancel stale missing-target notifications, and settle the terminal missing location.
8021.caveats: Screenshots are from a labelled real-hook harness, not a full app. Mobile, desktop packaging and installed release timing were not separately verified.
